description: Headline facts for a UK area: median sold price and its 12-month change, household income, population, private-renter share, deprivation, flood risk, broadband, council tax, the live listings pulse, live rents (active rent listings and median asking rent a month), the asking rental yield and average private rent, recorded crime per 1,000 residents (withheld where the police data has gaps), and people killed or seriously injured on the roads over three years. Takes a postcode, a postcode district or a place name (a borough name returns its best-matching district and lists the others). Optional response_format: "concise" (about 150 words) or "detailed" (default). The result also carries the figures as structured data. England & Wales only (Scotland and Northern Ireland are not covered). Each figure carries its year or date. It describes the area as it is and does not forecast prices. Give a full postcode or a postcode sector (for example "E17 7") to also get the sold price of that sector (median only with 10 or more sales in 12 months).

area.description: A postcode ("E17 7AB"), postcode district ("E17") or place name ("Walthamstow", "Hackney")

response_format.description: 'concise' (about 150 words: price, income, deprivation, live market and rents) or 'detailed' (default: every headline fact)
